summary: What every app has: the template's pins (board layer + console) - every recipe is checked against them - and the SDK fix new_app.sh applies (drv_gpio.c opens IOPORT once).
evidence: SDK VISION-BOARD 1.3.0 projects/vision_board_blink_led (base of every app)
readme: blink example: the blue LED of the RGB LED (P102) blinks; 'can be the base project of your own work' - new_app.sh copies it for every app

patches.what: every rt_pin_mode() called R_IOPORT_Open(), which re-applies the whole FSP pin setup and undoes pins set at run time (found with usb-cdc: USB_CH_SEL went back to the USB-HS path after the board layer set its LED/KEY pins, and the PC saw no device) - new_app.sh applies it since 2026-10-31
